'''Stanel Andaren Thul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] and the father of [[Daria Thul]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Stanel Thul was in charge of House Thul's forces at [[Outpost Bolym]].<ref name="Traitor">{{TORcite|type=general|Traitor|Alderaan}}</ref> His daughter, [[Daria Thul|Daria]], led an inspection team until they were captured by [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. Stanel was worried and tasked an Imperial spacer to rescue his daughter and three Inspection teams from the Hive. As his daughter was returned to him, he was shocked by the condition she was in.<ref name="Hive Mined">{{TORcite|type=general|Hive Mined|Alderaan}}</ref>

He and [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Craige Graf]] of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] later tasked the Imperial spacer with destroying a nearby [[Ulgo Fortress|fortress of House Ulgo]]. After the job was done, Stanley announced that he could now use his forces for rooting out the nearby [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="Pre-Emptive Strike">{{TORcite|type=general|Pre-Emptive Strike|Alderaan}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Upon returning his daughter to Stanel, the player is given the choice to either suggest taking revenge on the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]] (dark side choice) or to give her time to accustom herself (light side choice).<ref name="Hive Mined" />
